instances.prompt:
Scene: Blocked turning kick with causal reaction. Duration 8s.
[0.50-1.20s] fighter_a: loads weight onto the left leg and turns the pelvis.
[0.90-1.30s] fighter_a: plants and stabilizes the left support foot toward ground.
[1.30-2.20s] fighter_a: executes a right turning kick toward fighter_b.left_forearm.
[1.75-2.15s] fighter_b: raises the left forearm into a compact guard block toward fighter_a.right_foot.
[2.05-2.55s] fighter_b: compresses locally at the guard, then shifts the root backward.
[2.20-3.10s] fighter_a: retracts the right leg and returns to a balanced guard.
Contact at 2.00s: fighter_a.right_foot -> fighter_b.left_forearm (guard_contact).
Control intent — interaction.contacts: {"contact_id":"contact.blocked_kick","sites":["right_foot","left_forearm"],"time_s":2.0}.
Control intent — camera.trajectory: {"kind":"static_then_shake","shake_start_s":2.0}.
Control intent — performance.laban: {"fighter_a":{"flow":"bound","space":"direct","time":"sudden","weight":"strong"}}.
